title: Uncovering genetic interactions in the DNA repair network in response to endogenous damage and ionizing radiation
model: eHAP-iCas9 cells, combinatorial dual-guide library of 461 DNA-repair genes (>100,000 gene pairs)
contrast: IR day15 vs control day14 (2 vs 2), single-gene abundance
paper_method: Combinatorial genetic-interaction (epistasis) scoring over guide pairs; single-gene phenotypes from gene-vs-nontargeting constructs
paper_calls: Genetic-interaction map (e.g. BRCA1 x PARP10, UBR5 x MRE11, PARP1 x PARP2); no short single-gene hit list
barcs_calls: 0 genes at FDR 0.10 (model and control null) in the single-gene IR vs day14 marginal; controls well-calibrated (0% at raw p<0.05)
named_hits: No single-gene DDR gene separates: Lig4 #71, Atm #219, Xrcc5 #255, Brca2 #258, Ubr5 #262, Brca1 #453 of 459, all FDR ~1
verdict: BARCS models single-construct abundance, not the genetic interactions between guide pairs that are the paper's entire point, so it cannot reproduce the paper's findings; its single-gene IR marginal is correctly null (0 hits, controls well-calibrated), matching the paper's own premise that single-gene DDR effects are modest and the signal is combinatorial.
